headline: Oil Falls 3.89 Percent To $97.47 As A Sanction Waiver May Add Russian Fuel
narrative: Oil fell 3.89 percent to $97.47 after Reuters reported that a Trump sanction waiver may lead to more Russian fuel supplies. The crude pipe is supply: a waiver that may add Russian barrels is money leaving the price of oil, not a bid for scarce fuel. Yahoo Finance reported the same waiver as the reason oil prices slid.
author: jordan
